AI Overview
Ragdoll Drop is a popular physics-based action and simulation game. 
How the Game Works
Objective: Throw, drop, or launch a floppy ragdoll character through levels filled with traps, hazards, and obstacles to cause as much damage as possible. 
Mechanics: You arrange or interact with tools like rotating propellers, hammers, swords, maces, rockets, and catapults to increase impact force and score higher multipliers. 
Vehicles & Skins: You can test out bizarre vehicles like shopping carts, complete special quests, and unlock secret character skins. 
Platforms: You can play it for free directly in a web browser on desktop or mobile devices through Poki or Ragdoll Drop.
